beaches.name: Gomati
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is customary on the central part of the sandy beach, by the dunes. A naturist directory carries July 2022 and August 2024 reports citing local confirmation; a beach bar operates at one end. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Thanos (nudist cove)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported in a small cove beyond a rock at the end of the beach. A naturist directory carries July 2022 and August 2024 reports, the 2022 one citing local confirmation; reaching it means wading a few metres. The main beach with its bars is swimwear.
